title: Special Skills
summary: Passive bonuses. Every unlocked Special Skill applies at once.

rows: Start each game with 1 Ultimate Skill.
From the start, then collect 20 coins of any kind
Grants a 20% chance to get an extra +1 to your combo when a combo-increasing effect triggers.
7 days after the event opens, then collect 30 coins of any kind
An additional item appears on the field every time your combo increases by 30.
7 days after the event opens, then collect 40 coins of any kind
Increases combo duration. (+0.3 s, to 1.5 s)
14 days after the event opens, then collect 40 coins of any kind
Increases points from items and coins by 20%.
14 days after the event opens, then collect 50 coins of any kind
